text: {"rules":[{"id":"LUNG-SCREEN-LDCT-50-80","version":"March 2021","title":"Annual lung cancer screening with LDCT, adults 50-80 with 20 pack-year history who currently smoke or quit within 15 years","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends annual screening for lung cancer with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) in adults aged 50 to 80 years who have a 20 pack-year smoking history and currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years.","grade":"B","effective_date":"March 2021","action":"Perform annual low-dose CT lung cancer screening","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"age\": {\"min\": 50, \"max\": 80, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"adults aged 50 to 80 years\"}, {\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"pack_years\", \"pick\": \"latest\", \"value\": {\"op\": \">=\", \"threshold\": 20, \"unit\": \"pack-years\"}}, \"quote\": \"20 pack-year smoking history\", \"note\": \"Interpreted as at least 20 pack-years; no lookback window imposed (any recorded value)\"}, {\"any\": [{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"current_smoker\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"currently smoke\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"smoking quit date (quit within the past 15 years)\"}, \"quote\": \"have quit within the past 15 years\"}], \"quote\": \"currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years\"}], \"quote\": \"adults aged 50 to 80 years who have a 20 pack-year smoking history and currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years\"}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"ldct_lung\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"annual screening for lung cancer with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT)\"}","exclusions":"[{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"clinician judgment of a health problem substantially limiting life expectancy or ability/willingness to have curative lung surgery\"}, \"quote\": \"develops a health problem that substantially limits life expectancy or the ability or willingness to have curative lung surgery\"}]"}],"coverage_notes":["Former-smoker eligibility ('have quit within the past 15 years') depends on a smoking quit date, which structured EHR data does not reliably hold; encoded as uncomputable, so former smokers cannot be computed into the denominator.","Discontinuation 'once a person has not smoked for 15 years' is handled only implicitly via the denominator (current smoker or quit within 15 years); it is not separately computable because quit date is unavailable.","Discontinuation for a health problem limiting life expectancy or ability/willingness to have curative lung surgery requires clinician judgment and patient preference; encoded as an uncomputable exclusion.","Pack-year threshold interpreted as >= 20 pack-years; the pack_years observation has no lookback window because the text gives none (latest recorded value used).","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('March 2021 *') whose meaning is not explained in this section."]}
